PART 1 — where is the same-colour bar?
Pooled threshold: 0.01400 (95% confidence interval 0.00963 to 0.02036), from 64 answers.
Two colours closer than this were usually called the same; further apart, usually called different.
The prior we came in with was 0.01582; the measured bar is 0.89 times that.
